Subject: SOC2 packet + proposed timeline for review

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Orchard AI is primarily evaluating inference latency and data residency controls for a customer-facing feature; procurement needs an idea of implementation timeline and cost at the committed-throughput level.

I attached our latest SOC 2 packet and a short evidence index to make it easier for your security team to find items (policies, encryption details, retention rules, audit logs). You can also view the packet here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodSOC2

Attachments: [Redwood_SOC2_Packet_March2027.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

Requested next steps I suggested on the call:
- Security: quick Q&A to validate controls (30 min)
- Procurement: PO / contracting path and estimated start date
- Technical: brief runbook for VPC/private deployment if you need on-prem options

Can you share who on your side will own review and an approximate timeframe? If it helps, Marissa (cc'd) can join any security syncs or procurement conversations.

Thanks — happy to get a meeting on the calendar.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

If it's helpful, we can:
- Book a 30-min Q&A with our security lead (Rishi, cc'd) to run through encryption keys, retention, and audit logs

Marissa can also coordinate contracting next steps if you have a procurement owner identified. Are you still good for a review this month, or should we push to the first week of April?

No rush — just trying to understand priority so we can allocate the right folks.

Thanks,
Evelyn

Evelyn —

Thanks for the follow-up and for sharing the packet. Apologies for the delay — security had a couple of questions after a quick pass:

1) Encryption at rest: can you confirm whether customer data is encrypted with customer-managed keys (BYOK) in multi-region deployments, or if it is KMS-managed by Redwood?
2) Data retention: we need a clear retention / deletion workflow for PCI-adjacent data and the export process for audit.
3) Audit logs: would it be possible to get a sample of the log schema or a short exporter spec?

I've attached our internal questionnaire with the high-priority items (Orchard_Security_Questions.pdf). Procurement is also asking for an SOW outline and ballpark pricing so they can start the internal PO discussion.

Would Rishi be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow or Thursday morning PST to go over these items? If so, propose 10:00–10:30am PST on Thu 18 Mar or 11:00–11:30am PST on Wed 17 Mar.

Thanks — Priya (cc) is our security lead and will run the review.

Best,
Tom Baker
Head of Product Security | Orchard AI
T: (646) 555-0123
